_note: Which employments' salary is "payable by or on behalf of the Government" for Schedule XV para 1(c) (DED-SCHEDULE-XV's note: "(c)'s 'to the extent of 20 % of salary' is the GOVERNMENT_DEFERRED_ANNUITY sub-cap on GOVERNMENT_SALARY, the Government employments' pay in money under the head"; OQ-16, D-154): an employment whose employer is the Central or a State Government (employer.kind = GOVERNMENT). Read twice: the employments whose salary makes GOVERNMENT_SALARY, and the employments a pay line whose sub-cap reads GOVERNMENT_SALARY must come from. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80C(2)(iii), whose "one-fifth of the salary" DED-SCHEDULE-XV's note maps to the same sub-cap (D-154). Conditions only; provenance and introduction are DED-SCHEDULE-XV's (W-156d, D-349). Old regime only, as that row.
